blocks.text:
Tense | 脑内判断 | Common clues | Example
Simple future 一般将来 | 从现在看将来 | tomorrow, next..., will,
be going to | We will meet tomorrow.
Present continuous 现在进行 | 现在正在/阶段性进行 | now, at present,
currently | They are building a new
bridge.
Past continuous 过去进行 | 过去某时正在 | at 8 yesterday, when... | I was studying when he
called.
Present perfect 现在完成 | 过去发生但与现在有
关；或持续到现在 | since, for, already,
recently | She has lived here for five
years.
Past perfect 过去完成 | 两个过去动作，更早那
个 | by the time, before +
past | The train had left before we
arrived.
Present perfect continuous
现在完成进行（低频） | 持续到现在且强调过程 | for/since + ongoing
activity | He has been working all
morning.
Future in the past 过去将来
（低频） | 站在过去看将来 | would, was going to | She said she would return.
Future continuous 将来进行 | 未来某个时间正在发
生；或按安排届时会发
生 | at this time tomorrow,
this time next... | I will be taking the exam at
this time tomorrow.

rows: 时态不要只看一个时间词。先确定整段时间背景，再看这个动作与其他动作的先后。
